title: Toward Intelligent Fashion Design: A Texture and Shape Disentangled Generative Adversarial Network
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This paper proposes TSD-GAN, a texture and shape disentangled GAN for intelligent fashion design. It aims to disentangle texture and shape features of fashion items to generate new designs. The model uses a shared fashion attribute encoder, texture and shape mapping networks, and a multi-factor-based generator to synthesize mixed-style fashion items.
